description: This header file defines the interface for an Automation Service managing state machines, including initialization, cleanup, machine management, and retrieval of machine info. It includes function declarations, macros, and data structures related to automations within the littlesheens runtime environment.

methods.name: automationServiceInitPhase1
methods.description: Performs phase 1 of initialization required before IPC is enabled.

methods.name: automationServiceInitPhase2
methods.description: Performs phase 2 of initialization before automations are executed.

methods.name: automationServiceCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and terminates the Automation Service.

methods.name: automationServiceRestore
methods.description: Restores backed up automations during a restore process, replacing current automations.

methods.name: getMachineState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified machine.

methods.name: automationServiceAddMachine
methods.description: Adds a new machine with specified ID, specification, and enabled status.

methods.name: automationServiceRemoveMachine
methods.description: Removes a machine by ID, destroying related resources.

methods.name: automationServiceGetMachineInfos
methods.description: Returns a list of MachineInfo objects registered within the service.

methods.name: machineInfoFreeFunc
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for MachineInfo objects in the list.
